title: Independently check #4483's identity (2) and Chernoff bounds (7)-(9) on actual flows (p7, p16): all hold with wide margins (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/pr4483-chernoff-check/`, an independent check of zxv's #4483 (`research/rank-convergence/PROOF.md`) §2–3 **on actual flows**. It covers the exact potential identity (2), the Chernoff bounds (7) and (8), and their consequence (9). #4532's critical-root funding inherits these, and with it #4535 and #4568. My #4529 checked #4483's gates and rank-one identity at `t = 1` only. **All checked claims are confirmed. No new κ.**

## Checks

My own flow code builds #4483's arbitrary-height flow at `G = (a+b)·⌊log_M ⌊N/m⌋⌋` and computes `H_t`, `R_t`, `I_t`, `B_t` and `F_t`. There are two cases: raw p7 with #4483's p7 geometry, and p16 (#4470) with #4532's p16 geometry. Exponents lie above each profile's moment crossing, since `T > P` is (7)'s premise.

| profile | ranks (height) | `(T−P)H_t / rhs(7)` | `R_t / rhs(8)` |
|---|---|---|---|
| p7 | 10^5 (2), 10^7 (4), 3·10^9 (6) | 28.0 → 13.5 → 9.97 | 0.304 → 0.123 → 0.096 |
| p16 | 2·10^5 (2), 2·10^8 (4) | 25.2 → 16.1 | 0.267 → 0.237 |

Across all 15 cases:
- **(2), exactly.** `I_t + R_t = B_t + F_t + (T−P)H_t` holds **exactly** as an identity of formal power sums `Σ c_x·x^t`, with integer coefficients and up to 16,252 bases. It therefore holds for **every** `t` at each checked rank. A rejection control is included.
- **(7), (8), (9).** They hold with wide margins.
- **Premises.** Ratio ordering and `q > 1` hold.

**Limitations:**
- These are finite heights (`G ≤ 6`). The all-height statement is #4483's written Chernoff argument, which these checks corroborate.
- Comparisons use floats, with margins far above rounding.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr4483-chernoff-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr4483-chernoff-check outcome=completed   (~45 s, stdlib only)
```

Head: `84c0fb3a39bcb1e4b8c48892bfdd8a6e7ae58a50`. Base: canonical main `f626db5c`.

Credit: zxv (#4483), Dillon (#4532), Cinna Davis (#4470), Jacob Alan Sussman. Prepared by Ryanson Jonathan with substantial Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) assistance.
